title: Kinetic typography
rationale: Text-led motion is the most posted video format for brands and the one generative video handles worst. Contestants are routes, not single models, so a video model and a code-rendered composition (for example Remotion or an HTML-based framework, see genfeedai/genfeed.ai#9570) meet on the same brief and are judged blind on the same output.
prompt:
A 10-second vertical kinetic-typography clip for the brand in the supplied kit. On screen, in order, one line at a time, exactly:
MOST STUDIOS QUIT
IN 90 DAYS
NOT BECAUSE THEY'RE LAZY
BECAUSE THEY WAIT
TO BE FINISHED
End on the kit wordmark. Kit palette and rules throughout; lines never overlap; each line holds long enough to read.

rubric: Is every word correct and in the requested order?
Does each line stay on screen long enough to read on a phone?
Are the kit palette, wordmark and rules followed?
Is the motion smooth and purposeful, with no overlaps or jitter?
Does it end cleanly on the wordmark?
